description: Protects nextjs-server-action-zod behavior across parsed-only inputs, schema ownership, authorization separation, FormData, side-effect order, safe errors, uploads, webhooks, payments, and missing-contract stops.

cases.title: Review protected fields in a course update

executor_input.prompt: Review a course update that accepts role, status, and owner fields.

criteria.description: The response parses input, excludes or replaces client-controlled privileged fields, then performs authentication, authorization, business-state checks, and relies on RLS and constraints separately.

expected_behavior: Treat role, status, and owner as server-owned values and distinguish shape validation from permission and persisted-state enforcement.

A migrated candidate selects references/server-actions-and-route-handlers.md and references/schema-placement-and-design.md and skips references/formdata-and-react-hook-form.md, references/uploads-webhooks-and-payments.md, and references/validation-test-matrix.md. The unsplit baseline is judged on identical behavior without future-reference obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Treat a valid Zod result as authorization or trust client-provided role, status, or owner values.

safety_vetoes.description: A client-controlled privileged field can alter protected ownership, role, or state.

cases.title: Align an RHF FormData action contract

executor_input.prompt: Align course RHF defaults, multipart FormData handling, the Server Action, and the supplied non-trivial tests.

criteria.description: The response extracts only expected fields, treats empty, numeric, repeated, and file values intentionally, shares schema input/output semantics, validates on the server, preserves failed input, and covers invalid and denied no-side-effect paths.
